title: 3 shelf system
text: 3 shelf system. Even though the photos show the shelves with the "lip" edge down, good luck.  There's only ONE way to put the shelf system together and that is with the lip edge up.  A spent a horrible amount of frustration time trying to get this put together as the directions laid out - finally gave up and called "customer support."  I was told, VERY SLOWLY - there is only ONE WAY the system can go together and that "MAY mean the lip edge is up."  GRRRRRRRRR  I don't like it.  The directions show and tell you NOTHING that is useful, except to call tech support.  OMG.  Of course, at this price point, you're not expecting much - and I wasn't really.  But I DID expect the directions to reflect the item I had in front of me.  If you are DETERMINED to have this shelf, here's a couple of hints...  the black clips do NOT adjoin to themselves and may pop off - the lip edge MUST be up - which definitely limits the use of these shelves - things MUST fit inside the lips...  and it "suggests" a rubber mallot  "may" be useful - don't try to put this together without one.  I'm just going to toss this and try something better - where the lip edges go down as they should.  What a mess.  - OH.  And there are 4 wheels... 2 regular, 2 with a "brake" switch...  Don't bother... the "brake" doesn't work AT ALL.  Just junk.

product_metadata.title: Whitmor Supreme Laundry Cart and Versatile Storage Solution - Chrome
features: Locking wheels for portability and stability
Shelves feature raised edges to keep items from sliding off
description: The Whitmor chrome supreme laundry cart is constructed of a durable chrome-steel frame to support a variety of household items. Perfect for creating more storage space in the laundry room, kitchen or garage, it offers easy portability with locking wheels so you can take it anywhere around the house. 3 solid shelves provide space for detergent, baskets and other laundry accessories, with raised edges to prevent items from falling off.

Supreme 3 tier cart. Cart is on wheels, which makes the item easy to move. Slim line makes cart easy to tuck into small areas yet has ample shelf space for all your laundry and ironing needs. Unit measures 9.13-Inch by 22.5-Inch by 31.75-Inch.
